description: This Java source file defines the class JMSPropertyMapper, which handles conversion between message headers and AMQP 1.0 properties and application properties for messaging. It includes methods for setting and getting message properties, mapping headers, and handling AMQP-specific property rules.

classes.name: JMSPropertyMapper
classes.description: A utility class for converting and mapping headers to and from JMS messages with AMQP 1.0 properties and application properties.

methods.name: setPropertiesAndApplicationProperties
methods.description: Sets headers as properties and application properties into an AMQP JMS message according to specific rules.

methods.name: getPropertiesAndApplicationProperties
methods.description: Retrieves headers from the properties and application properties of an AMQP JMS message.
